attributes.description: Progress to display, a fraction between 0 and max.

attributes.name: max
attributes.description: Maximum progress to display, defaults to 1.

attributes.name: indeterminate
attributes.description: Whether or not to display indeterminate progress, which gives no indication to how long an activity will take.

attributes.name: four-color
attributes.description: Whether or not to render indeterminate mode using 4 colors instead of one.

tags.name: md-linear-progress
tags.description: Linear progress indicators display progress by animating along the length of a fixed, visible track.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: Progress to display, a fraction between 0 and max.

attributes.name: max
attributes.description: Maximum progress to display, defaults to 1.

attributes.name: indeterminate
attributes.description: Whether or not to display indeterminate progress, which gives no indication to how long an activity will take.

attributes.name: four-color
attributes.description: Whether or not to render indeterminate mode using 4 colors instead of one.

tags.name: md-radio
tags.description: Radios behave like <input type="radio"> elements and form a group with the same name attribute. Only one radio can be selected in a group.

attributes.name: disabled
attributes.description: Whether or not the radio is disabled.

attributes.name: required
attributes.description: Whether or not the radio is required.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: The element value to use in form submission when checked.

attributes.name: checked
attributes.description: Whether or not the radio is selected.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: The HTML name to use in form submission.

attributes.name: form
attributes.description: The ID of the form to associate the radio with.

tags.name: md-ripple
tags.description: Ripples display on hover and press pointer interactions. They may be attached to a control in one of three ways.

attributes.name: disabled
attributes.description: Disables the ripple.

attributes.name: for
attributes.description: ID of the control element the ripple attaches to.

tags.name: md-outlined-segmented-button
tags.description: MdOutlinedSegmentedButton is the custom element for the Material Design outlined segmented button component. It is intended only for use as a child of a segmented button set.

attributes.name: disabled
attributes.description: Whether or not the segmented button is disabled.

attributes.name: selected
attributes.description: Whether or not the segmented button is selected.

attributes.name: label
attributes.description: The text label of the segmented button.

attributes.name: no-checkmark
attributes.description: Hides the checkmark shown on selected buttons.

attributes.name: has-icon
attributes.description: Set this to true when an icon is present.

tags.name: md-outlined-segmented-button-set
tags.description: MdOutlinedSegmentedButtonSet is the custom element for the Material Design outlined segmented button set component. Only segmented button components may be used as children.

attributes.name: multiselect
attributes.description: Whether or not the set allows selecting multiple buttons.

tags.name: md-filled-select
tags.description: Select menus display a list of choices on temporary surfaces and display the currently selected menu item above the menu.

attributes.name: quick
attributes.description: Opens the menu synchronously with no animation.

attributes.name: required
attributes.description: Whether or not the select is required.

attributes.name: disabled
attributes.description: Disables the select.

attributes.name: error-text
attributes.description: The error message that replaces supporting text when `error` is true. If `errorText` is an empty string, then the supporting text will continue to show.

attributes.name: label
attributes.description: The floating label for the field.

attributes.name: no-asterisk
attributes.description: Disables the asterisk on the floating label, when the select is required.

attributes.name: supporting-text
attributes.description: Conveys additional information below the select, such as how it should be used.

attributes.name: error
attributes.description: Gets or sets whether or not the select is in a visually invalid state.

attributes.name: menu-positioning
attributes.description: Whether or not the underlying md-menu should be position: fixed to display in a top-level manner, or position: absolute.

attributes.name: clamp-menu-width
attributes.description: Clamps the menu-width to the width of the select.

attributes.name: typeahead-delay
attributes.description: The max time between the keystrokes of the typeahead select / menu behavior before it clears the typeahead buffer.

attributes.name: has-leading-icon
attributes.description: Whether or not the text field has a leading icon. Used for SSR.

attributes.name: display-text
attributes.description: Text to display in the field. Only set for SSR.

attributes.name: menu-align
attributes.description: Whether the menu should be aligned to the start or the end of the select's textbox.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: The value of the currently selected option.

attributes.name: selected-index
attributes.description: The index of the currently selected option.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: The HTML name to use in form submission.

attributes.name: form
attributes.description: The ID of the form to associate the select with.

tags.name: md-select-option
tags.description: Select (also referred to as a dropdown menu) allows choosing a value from a fixed list of available options. It is analogous to the native HTML <select> element.

attributes.name: disabled
attributes.description: Disables the item and makes it non-selectable and non-interactive.

attributes.name: selected
attributes.description: Whether or not the SelectOption is selected.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: The form value associated with the Select Option.

tags.name: md-slider
tags.description: Sliders allow users to view and select a value (or range) along a track. They're ideal for adjusting settings such as volume and brightness, or for applying image filters.

attributes.name: disabled
attributes.description: Whether or not the slider is disabled.

attributes.name: min
attributes.description: The slider minimum value

attributes.name: max
attributes.description: The slider maximum value

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: The slider value displayed when range is false.

attributes.name: value-start
attributes.description: The slider start value displayed when range is true.

attributes.name: value-end
attributes.description: The slider end value displayed when range is true.

attributes.name: value-label
attributes.description: An optional label for the slider's value.

attributes.name: value-label-start
attributes.description: An optional label for the slider's start value.

attributes.name: value-label-end
attributes.description: An optional label for the slider's end value.

attributes.name: aria-label-start
attributes.description: Aria label for the slider's start handle.

attributes.name: aria-label-end
attributes.description: Aria label for the slider's end handle.

attributes.name: aria-valuetext-start
attributes.description: Aria value text for the slider's start value.

attributes.name: aria-valuetext-end
attributes.description: Aria value text for the slider's end value.

attributes.name: step
attributes.description: The step between values.

attributes.name: ticks
attributes.description: Whether or not to show tick marks.

attributes.name: labeled
attributes.description: Whether or not to show a value label when activated.

attributes.name: range
attributes.description: Whether or not to show a value range.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: The HTML name to use in form submission.

attributes.name: form
attributes.description: The ID of the form to associate the slider with.

tags.name: md-switch
tags.description: Switches toggle the state of an item on or off.

attributes.name: disabled
attributes.description: Disables the switch and makes it non-interactive.

attributes.name: selected
attributes.description: Puts the switch in the selected state and sets the form submission value to the value property.

attributes.name: icons
attributes.description: Shows both the selected and deselected icons.

attributes.name: show-only-selected-icon
attributes.description: Shows only the selected icon, and not the deselected icon. If true, overrides the behavior of the icons property.

attributes.name: required
attributes.description: When true, require the switch to be selected when participating in form submission. https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/HTML/Element/input/checkbox#validation

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: The value associated with this switch on form submission.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: The HTML name to use in form submission.

attributes.name: form
attributes.description: The ID of the form to associate the switch with.

tags.name: md-tabs
tags.description: Tabs organize groups of related content that are at the same level of hierarchy.

attributes.name: auto-activate
attributes.description: Whether or not to automatically select a tab when it is focused.

attributes.name: active-tab-index
attributes.description: The index of the currently active tab.

tags.name: md-primary-tab
tags.description: Primary tabs are placed at the top of the content pane under a top app bar. They display the main content destinations.

attributes.name: md-tab
attributes.description: Indicates that the element is a tab for the parent `<md-tabs>`.

attributes.name: active
attributes.description: Whether or not the tab is selected.

attributes.name: has-icon
attributes.description: In SSR, set this to true when an icon is present.

attributes.name: icon-only
attributes.description: In SSR, set this to true when there is no label and only an icon.

tags.name: md-secondary-tab
tags.description: Secondary tabs are used within a content area to further separate related content and establish hierarchy.

attributes.name: md-tab
attributes.description: Indicates that the element is a tab for the parent `<md-tabs>`.

attributes.name: active
attributes.description: Whether or not the tab is selected.

attributes.name: has-icon
attributes.description: In SSR, set this to true when an icon is present.

attributes.name: icon-only
attributes.description: In SSR, set this to true when there is no label and only an icon.

tags.name: md-filled-text-field
tags.description: Filled and outlined text fields are functionally identical. See choosing a text field for guidance on which one to use.

attributes.name: disabled
attributes.description: Whether or not the text field is disabled.

attributes.name: error
attributes.description: Gets or sets whether or not the text field is in a visually invalid state. This error state overrides the error state controlled by reportValidity().

attributes.name: error-text
attributes.description: The error message that replaces supporting text when error is true. If errorText is an empty string, then the supporting text will continue to show. This error message overrides the error message displayed by reportValidity().

attributes.name: label
attributes.description: The floating Material label of the textfield component.

attributes.name: no-asterisk
attributes.description: Disables the asterisk on the floating label, when the text field is required.

attributes.name: required
attributes.description: Indicates that the user must specify a value for the input before the owning form can be submitted.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: The current value of the text field. It is always a string.

attributes.name: prefix-text
attributes.description: An optional prefix to display before the input value.

attributes.name: suffix-text
attributes.description: An optional suffix to display after the input value.

attributes.name: has-leading-icon
attributes.description: Whether or not the text field has a leading icon. Used for SSR.

attributes.name: has-trailing-icon
attributes.description: Whether or not the text field has a trailing icon. Used for SSR.

attributes.name: supporting-text
attributes.description: Conveys additional information below the text field.

attributes.name: text-direction
attributes.description: Override the input text CSS `direction`.

attributes.name: rows
attributes.description: The number of rows to display for a `type="textarea"` text field.

attributes.name: cols
attributes.description: The number of cols to display for a `type="textarea"` text field.

attributes.name: inputmode
attributes.description: The input mode (keyboard type) for the text field.

attributes.name: max
attributes.description: Defines the greatest value in the range of permitted values.

attributes.name: maxlength
attributes.description: The maximum number of characters a user can enter into the text field.

attributes.name: min
attributes.description: Defines the most negative value in the range of permitted values.

attributes.name: minlength
attributes.description: The minimum number of characters a user can enter into the text field.

attributes.name: pattern
attributes.description: A regular expression that the text field's value must match.

attributes.name: placeholder
attributes.description: Defines the text displayed in the textfield when it has no value.

attributes.name: readonly
attributes.description: Indicates whether or not a user should be able to edit the text field.

attributes.name: multiple
attributes.description: Indicates that input accepts multiple email addresses.

attributes.name: step
attributes.description: Returns or sets the element's step attribute.

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: The `<input>` type to use, defaults to "text".

attributes.name: autocomplete
attributes.description: Describes what, if any, type of autocomplete functionality the input provides.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: The HTML name to use in form submission.

attributes.name: form
attributes.description: The ID of the form to associate the text field with.
